Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who we are: 
 Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world.
 We are looking for: 
 We are looking for a Senior Java Developer to join our international development team that delivers first class applications for our businesses and clients.
 What you will do: 
Develop and maintain Java/Spring Boot backend services.
Build and enhance REST APIs and microservices.
Collaborate with business and technical teams to deliver features.
Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code.
Identify and resolve technical issues.
Contribute to code reviews and continuous improvement.
 What you must have: 
5+ years of experience with Java and Spring Boot/Spring Framework
Good knowledge of REST APIs and microservices
Basic experience with PostgreSQL (SQL queries, data modeling)
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently
Fluent English (spoken and written)
Exposure to AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) and familiarity with AI coding workflows, prompt engineering, and token-based LLM integrations is a strong advantage.
 What's in it for you: 
Extended compensation and benefits package
Continuous learning opportunities to enhance your professional and soft skills
A great working environment with people who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do and understand the importance of team spirit
 We really welcome open-minded and committed people: 
Eager to take on new challenges and learn new things
Who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do
Who enjoy sharing knowledge and understand the importance of team spirit.
 ***Only eligible candidates will be contacted to move forward in the recruitment process
